text:
maria_arch: follow-up idea on CP separation: introduce a 'locality boundary' per-region to own egress IP leases and affinity. keeps CP global but reduces hairpin.

kevin_p: sketch? how is this different from per-customer peering?

maria_arch: ascii:
```
global-cp
  |
  +-- region-1-locality -> egress-pool-1 (ENI/NAT) -> customer-vpc / internet
  +-- region-2-locality -> egress-pool-2
```
locality = thin operator: lease manager, short-lived certs, metrics. no model traffic.

anya_s: security/rotation concerns?

maria_arch: short TTL tokens from CP, KMS-wrapped boundary keys, nonce anti-replay. boundaries renew leases; if CP unreachable, existing leases run to expiry (default 10m).

kevin_p: private-only customers?

maria_arch: same surface; egress-pool maps to PrivateLink/peering instead of NAT.

ops-bot: checklist generated: [lease-protocol v1], [boundary image], [metrics-export], [cutover-playbook].

anya_s: rollout: feature-flag per-tenant, start in a single region with low-traffic tenants. monitor p95 and NAT exhaustion.

maria_arch: will draft RFC appendix with token format, TTLs, health signals. assigning action items in RFC.
